steps.objective: Inspect README.md to extract the public interface, reporting rules, and any constraints for the reconciliation project.
success_evidence: README.md content is read successfully, capturing interface and reporting rules.

steps.objective: Implement the reconciliation project according to the interface and reporting rules from README.md, including exact arithmetic, under/overpayment reporting, quarantine of bad rows, and handling of unusable input files without overwriting previous reports.
success_evidence: Project files are created containing the reconciliation logic, quarantine mechanism, and safe arithmetic.
constraints: Must not use floating-point arithmetic for monetary calculations.
Must define a clear public interface consistent with README.md.
Must include an entry point for repeatable execution.

steps.objective: Write automated tests covering underpayment/overpayment detection, floating-point precision, quarantine of bad rows, preservation of previous report on unusable input, and interface conformance.
success_evidence: Test files are created with comprehensive assertions for all listed behaviors.
constraints: Tests must be runnable without modifying project source files.
Tests must use the public interface defined in README.md.

steps.objective: Create operating instructions (e.g., OPERATING.md) describing how to run the reconciliation process, expected inputs/outputs, quarantine location, and error handling.
success_evidence: Operating instructions document is created with clear repeatable steps.
constraints: Instructions must reference the actual project entry point and interface.
Must include steps for running on new data.

steps.objective: Execute the automated test suite to verify all reconciliation behaviors, precision, quarantine, previous report intact, and interface conformance.
success_evidence: Test suite runs and all tests pass, with output indicating zero failures.
constraints: Must not modify project files during execution.
Test execution must use the project's public interface.

steps.objective: Read back the operating instructions file to confirm it contains the required operating steps and clarity for repeatable use.
success_evidence: The contents of OPERATING.md are read and include commands for running reconciliation, inputs, outputs, and error handling.

patch.reason: Initial plan: inspect README to learn interface and rules, implement project with exact arithmetic and quarantine, add tests and instructions, execute tests, and verify instructions.

goal_obligations.predicate: The project produces a reconciliation report that identifies underpayments and overpayments from invoice and payment CSV inputs.
Reconciliation calculations avoid floating-point errors (exact arithmetic is used).
Invalid rows are quarantined (placed in a separate location or output).
When an input file is unusable (e.g., missing or malformed), the previous report file remains unchanged.
The project conforms to the public interface and reporting rules specified in README.md.
The project includes operating instructions (how to run, inputs, outputs, error handling).
The project provides a repeatable process (e.g., command or script) for running reconciliation on new data.
